examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Alignment Mode
examples.description: This example demonstrates the alignment and scaling effects of the ImageSpan component using the verticalAlign and objectFit attributes, available since API version 10.

examples.title: Example 2: Setting the Background Style
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to set the background style for text using the textBackgroundStyle attribute, available since API version 11.

examples.title: Example 3: Adding Events to an Image
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to add load success and load error events to the ImageSpan component using onComplete and onError, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting the Color Filter
examples.description: This example demonstrates the effect of setting a color filter for the ImageSpan component using the colorFilter attribute, available since API version 14.

examples.title: Example 5: Setting a Placeholder Image
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the alt attribute to display a placeholder image in the ImageSpan component while loading a network image, available since API version 12.

examples.title: Example 6: Displaying an SVG Image Using the supportSvg2 Property
examples.description: This example shows how to enable enhanced SVG usability capabilities through the SVG tag parsing enhancement feature by configuring the supportSvg2 attribute, available since API version 22.
